title: Seven-piece bands, picking the bass and the move to string bass in Los Angeles
summary: A typical seven-piece band had no piano. Foster says he started picking the bass in four beats to the bar, and tells how a broken tuba valve in Los Angeles led him to demonstrate string bass.
